text:
In August I bought a domain.

Today it has 300+ free calculators and 700+ pages in Hindi.

No team. No agency. No paid tools for the automation.

What I learned in 3 months:

1. People don't search "PM Kisan scheme details".
   They search "PM Kisan ki agli kist kab aayegi".
   Build for the question, not the topic.

2. A calculator beats a blog post.
   People stay, type their own numbers, and come back.

3. Google is slow with new sites.
   600+ of my pages are still waiting to be indexed. That's normal. Keep going.

4. Automate the boring parts.
   My Shorts and daily updates now run on their own.

I'm now building the same systems for other businesses.

What would you automate first in your business?
